telemetry.testName: records one whiteboard editor-asset serve span per request

features.title: Project whiteboards
features.summary: Excalidraw boards stored per project on the Host: create, draw with autosave, rename, delete to Recently deleted and restore; the editor bundle loads only when a board opens.
failureModes: A save with a stale revision is refused; the editor offers Load newer version or Keep mine.
A scene over 900 KiB (the dshx API payload budget) is refused with a crop-images recovery message.
The editor bundle cannot be fetched; the board view offers Retry.
A symlinked whiteboard directory or database is refused.

verification.testName: creates, lists per project, reads, updates with revisions, renames, deletes and restores
parks a stale save in conflict until the user keeps theirs or loads the newer version

features.title: Agent-drawn diagrams
features.summary: whiteboard_write queues Mermaid or Excalidraw skeleton source; the editor converts it into editable shapes the next time the board opens, and whiteboard_read returns the scene and its texts.
features.currentSurface: agent tools: whiteboard_list, whiteboard_read, whiteboard_write, whiteboard_rename, whiteboard_delete, whiteboard_restore
failureModes: Mermaid that does not parse leaves the source queued; the board offers Discard queued diagram.
Mermaid and skeleton in one write are refused.

verification.testName: binds every method as a tool; reads are read-only and delete needs confirm: true
